configuration.scheduler: cosine multiplicative from 1 to .1 over 50 epochs; fixed same schedule for B and C
configuration.batchnorm: Original FrozenBatchNorm formula and running statistics preserved; affine buffers promoted to trainable parameters in C; all CNN parameters trainable
configuration.normalizer: Original FP32 feature moments fitted on gradient-training T only; fixed during fine-tuning
configuration.checkpoint_selection: highest validation AP, ties lower weighted BCE then earliest epoch
configuration.stopping: after at least25 epochs, stop after10 epochs without AP improvement, or50; unsafe numerical failures stop immediately
configuration.calibration: Original C held-out recording groups; unweighted sigmoid LogisticRegression C1
configuration.sensor: Original statistics, balanced logistic C1 on original G; separate C calibrator; deterministic25 fits reused across arms/seeds
configuration.fusion: Original unweighted logistic C1 on [p_visual,p_sensor], fitted to inner OOF rows only; fixed threshold .5
configuration.extra_short_reference: Supplementary matched short A_r chosen from B epoch5/10 snapshots using the same V; no extra CNN fit
configuration.checkpoint_retention: Two alternating resumable generations, one best model, optional short-reference weights; retain all final selected models and metrics
configuration.resume: Completed-epoch boundaries only; an interrupted incomplete epoch is rolled back and replayed from last complete boundary, never counted as completed scientific exposure
configuration.other_gpu_job: Wait without terminating it; only one GPU-heavy job allowed
configuration.task_authority: Latest user attachment authorizes complete Phase1; no wall-hour cutoff; no commit/push
